fact: INM-GB states it completed installation of a CLIMSA/PUMA2025 station on 21-25 August 2026, tested and accepted, receiving EUMETSAT Meteosat Third Generation data in near real time at up to 10-minute intervals.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Guinea-Bissau among eight member states still pending a PUMA station as at 12 May 2026, under a Tecnavia service contract for all 49 member states.
